forwardFall:
Use case: identity-preserve / animation sprite sheet.
Create a transparent spritesheet of 12 separated cutouts for a SHORT CHUNKY FORWARD DEATH animation in a first-person medieval woodcut game. Use the attached figures as exact costume/style references. Do not redesign their clothing.
Layout: 4 EQUAL COLUMNS by 3 EQUAL ROWS, landscape 4:3 canvas, ideally 2048x1536. Each cell a separate full sprite with generous transparent gutters, no drawings crossing cells, no labels, no grid, no background. No ground plane or shadow painted outside the silhouette.
Columns left to right: (1) original bucket-helmet knight, grubby dirty-orange tabard, metal arms/legs, wooden shield and sword; (2) tall slim Frank priest, orange hood UP, ragged warm-grey robe, rope belt, book; (3) Dark Wizard, ragged black robe and crooked floppy black hat, long grey hair, crooked staff; (4) Timmy, chainmail coif hood, pale torn tunic with orange patches, belt of bottles, short torch.
Reference image 1 gives rear knight and general style (ignore its outdated fat bald priest). Reference image 2 is the actual tall hood-up Frank. Reference image 3 is actual Timmy. Reference image 4 is actual wizard.

ALL FIGURES face AWAY FROM CAMERA into the top of the picture. We see backs of heads, backs of clothing, backs of legs. Do not draw side-view corpses or front-facing figures.
ROW 1: same four figures suddenly BUCKLING FORWARD, knees bent, shoulders hunched, arms beginning to reach ahead, still mostly upright, back toward us.
ROW 2: corresponding figures PITCHING FACE-FIRST AWAY from us, torso nearly horizontal in foreshortened perspective, hands reaching toward ground in the distance, knees giving way and soles visible closer to camera. Clear dramatic fall, head is farther up the image than feet.
ROW 3: corresponding figures fully landed FACE DOWN, stomach on the ground, arms splayed forward, legs pointing back toward viewer. Rear foreshortened view, close boot soles, head farther away at top, clearly a limp dead body lying on its belly, not kneeling, not lying on its back. Weapon/book/staff/torch dropped closely beside its owner within the cell; torch extinguished. No gore needed.
Keep each character's anatomy, equipment and apparent head size consistent between its 3 cells, with intentional foreshortening. This is 3 distinct animation key drawings per character, not 12 unrelated designs.
Style: exact reference medieval worn woodblock print, irregular black contours, carved hatching, parchment interiors, restrained dirty-orange cloth, warm grey brown. NO soft rendering, no grey halo, no glossy metal, no yellow skin. True transparency around silhouettes; solid paper-coloured opaque interiors. NO text, effects, captions, frames or motion arrows.
